AmbDescription:
Come join us for our weekly Canicross group run on Thursday evenings at the Old Reedy Creek Road Trailhead!
All fitness levels are welcome, and we generally run an out-and back route, so whether you're a seasoned runner or just starting out, you'll have a blast running or hiking with your four-legged friend.
\*depending on weather our routes are either:
The multiuse trail into Umstead (wide fine gravel road) generally up to 4 miles
OR The lake trail into Lake Crabtree County Park (single track trails)-Roughly 1.1 miles to the lake access/turn around
What you need to know:
-As a general rule, please respect all dogs' space during canicross, and absolutely no on-leash, nose to nose greetings. This is not an event for dogs to be social with others, please keep space between your dog and the dog in front of you, and announce if you're going to be passing. This is a reactive dog friendly group.
-Gear: A Waist belt, bungee leash, and y-front harness are all you need to get started. We have plenty of extra belts/bungee lines/harnesses to try, and can help with fitting equipment too!
-We are not the fastest/slowest group out there, and all speeds are welcome (even those who need to hike)! If we are on the singletrack trails, we ensure no one is dropped. However, as the double track trail is a straight gravel road out and back, I cannot not guarantee someone will always be with you, but we do ensure everyone makes it back to the parking lot 🙂
We cancel for thunderstorms and extreme heat (definition of extreme heat varies based on time of year)
You may want to bring lights as sunset gets earlier

AmbDescription:
We will meet at the parking lot off of Highway 933 before Nucor. Address is to Nucor to get you as close as possible. We will be doing an out and back (run/walk) of the unpaved trail, approximately 3 miles. All skill levels and speeds welcome, you can do as much or as little of the route as you would like. Please keep your and your dog’s physical limitations and current fitness level in mind when participating. You do not need to be a NACC member to participate.

Since this is intended to be an opportunity to learn about canicross it is not necessary to have a full canicross setup. However, no flexi-leashes, face halters, or “no-pull” harnesses will be allowed. A non-restrictive Y-front harness is preferred along with a bungee leash if available. Dogs must be 12 months or older for their safety.

NACC has a strict “No greet” policy for the safety of all participating dogs. Please do not let your dog approach other dogs or humans and provide space if passing on the trail.

You must sign a waiver if you haven't done so before: https://nacanicross.fillout.com/t/dQrpDEnWaEus.

Your dog is required to be ON LEASH at all times. No exceptions.

Be sure to clean up after yourself and your dog.
